items.title: Al Wynn Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: I think Baby Dots has one. There's two or three of the musicians that's got them around here... If Baby's got it, he wouldn't let me see it. I don't know that I, I don't believe Baby has one. I've never seen it over there.

ctx.x: Huh? The drummer? Yeah. What was the band?
Rudy. Rudy. Rudy Richardson. No, I didn't know him. You didn't know him? No. Rudy Richardson.

Well, that's the man that practically inspirational, Lionel Hampton playing cellophones. This boy played cellophones. And all those men, like we used on that, the Chinese job we used, well I didn't use, what's it called, on drums, I used, what's the boy's name, that died in, Ernest Parker. I used him. Ernest Parker, man. Yeah, he's from Minneapolis. He was a good drummer too. And on all the records that Miney made, that's when he didn't use, what did you say they call it? What did you say the current player was…
